benchmark_metadata.name: Phase 6I Independent Validation Benchmark
benchmark_metadata.purpose: Independent holdout evaluation of Candidate B. No query from Phase 6H development set is reused.
design_principles: Every in-corpus gold target is derived from authoritative promoted_corpus_manifest.json provenance, NOT intuition
Every OOC case references a condition genuinely absent from the 14-condition active corpus
No query is reused from Phase 6H challenge set or Phase 6H regression set
Balanced coverage across 4 language modalities: English, Native Bangla, Standard Banglish, Abbreviated Banglish
Multiple clinical conditions per modality to avoid condition-specific overfitting
Both disambiguation-critical queries (bleeding types, burn types) and straightforward queries included

sample_size_justification.rationale: With N=36 in-corpus cases and a hypothesized population R@5 of ~85%, a two-sided 95% Wilson confidence interval width is approximately ±12pp — sufficient to distinguish meaningful improvement over CONTROL (~55%) but NOT claimed to be statistically powered for fine-grained differences. The benchmark is labeled 'INDEPENDENT VALIDATION CANDIDATE' precisely because sample size limits formal inference. The 4 OOC cases test safety/abstention behavior and are scored separately.
sample_size_justification.conditions_covered: All 14 NHS conditions represented at least once across modalities
sample_size_justification.statistical_significance_claim: NOT claimed. This benchmark provides a directional validation signal, not a formal hypothesis test.

primary_metric.name: Final Chunk Recall@5
primary_metric.definition: Fraction of in-corpus cases where at least one chunk from the correct source document appears in the final Top-5

ooc_evaluation.metric: False positive rate — fraction of OOC cases where system returns HIGH confidence retrieval for an unrelated condition
ooc_evaluation.target: 0% HIGH confidence false positives (ideal); report actual rate

cross_condition_contamination.definition: Cases where the top-1 retrieved document belongs to a clinically unrelated condition (e.g., nosebleed query returning burns)
cross_condition_contamination.report: Count and list all contaminated cases

order: 4. 0% regression on English + Native Bangla controls
selection_rule.note: This rule is pre-registered and MUST NOT be changed after seeing validation results

minimum_acceptance_criteria.recall_at_5: >= 75% on in-corpus cases (directional threshold, not a formal test)
minimum_acceptance_criteria.regression: 0% regression on English and Native Bangla slices vs CONTROL
minimum_acceptance_criteria.ooc_safety: No HIGH confidence false positives on OOC cases
